annotations.title: Copy a photo onto a listing from a web address

description: Fetch a public image (https, max 5MB, jpeg/png/webp) and add it to one of your listings (max 6 photos). For moving your owner’s own listing over from eBay, Vinted or similar, when you have the direct image URLs (eBay usually blocks fetching its pages; then use get_photo_upload_link instead). Only for photos of your owner’s own item. Requires GLONGUS_API_KEY.

listing_id.description: Listing id to attach the photo to

photo_url.description: Direct https URL of the image

name: add_listing_photo_from_url
title: Copy a photo onto a listing from a web address
